questions.stem: A 40-year-old alcoholic presented to the emergency department due to recurrent nosebleeds. He has a history of alcohol abuse and chronic mental illness. A more detailed check-up reveals that his gums are swollen, purple, and spongy. Physical examination revealed multiple splinter hemorrhages near the distal ends of the nail on patient’s fingers and also wound healing is not proper in this patient.Which of the following is the most probable cause of patient's examination findings?
